obligations.title: Security Risk Management Plan
obligations.verbatim: Integrate security risk management into the overall risk management process (ISO 14971). Security risk management must consider: confidentiality, integrity, availability. Apply throughout the entire lifecycle.
extracted_requirements: Integrate security risk management with the ISO 14971 risk management process — security risks must appear in the device risk file
Apply security risk management throughout the entire product lifecycle (not just development)

obligations.title: Secure Development Plan
obligations.verbatim: Include security activities in the software development plan. Plan must address: threat modeling, secure design principles, security testing, vulnerability management. Define security requirements sources (regulatory, standards, organizational policies).

extracted_requirements.Include security activities in the SDP: threat modeling, secure design, security testing, vulnerability management

extracted_requirements.Identify security requirements sources: FDA cybersecurity guidance, IEC 81001-5-1, organizational security policies

extracted_requirements: Define the process for tracking and resolving security issues throughout development

obligations.title: Security Requirements
obligations.verbatim: Derive security requirements from: security risk assessment, regulatory requirements, intended use environment threat landscape, data protection requirements (PHI/PII if applicable). Security requirements must cover: authentication and access control, authorization and privilege management, audit logging and accountability, data confidentiality (at rest and in transit), data integrity, secure communication, software update/patch mechanisms, cryptographic controls.
extracted_requirements: Derive security requirements from security risk assessment + FDA cybersecurity guidance + PHI/PII obligations

extracted_requirements.SRS must include security requirements c: authentication, access control, role-based authorization, audit logging

extracted_requirements.SRS must cover data protection: confidentiality at rest and in transit, data integrity, encryption standards

extracted_requirements.SRS must address software update securit: authenticated OTA update mechanism with integrity verification

extracted_requirements.SRS must specify cryptographic controls: approved algorithms, key management, certificate handling

obligations.title: Secure Software Architecture
obligations.verbatim: Apply secure design principles: defense in depth, least privilege, secure defaults, fail secure, separation of duties, minimize attack surface. Document security architecture decisions. Identify trust boundaries between components.

extracted_requirements.Apply secure design principles in the SA: defense in depth, least privilege, secure defaults, fail secure, minimize attack surface

extracted_requirements: Document security architecture decisions as architectural records
Identify and explicitly document trust boundaries between components (SaMD/non-SaMD boundary is a trust boundary)
Separation of duties must be reflected in the architecture (e.g., Management Services cannot alter Intra-Op clinical data unilaterally)

obligations.title: Secure Detailed Design
obligations.verbatim: Follow secure coding standards. Use static analysis tools to detect vulnerabilities. Perform code reviews with security focus. Manage third-party components (SOUP) for known vulnerabilities.
extracted_requirements: Follow a defined secure coding standard (e.g., OWASP, CERT C, or equivalent)
Use static analysis (SAST) tools in the CI/CD pipeline to detect common vulnerability patterns
Conduct security-focused code reviews for high-risk components
Track SOUP/third-party dependencies for known vulnerabilities (CVE/NVD monitoring)

obligations.title: Secure Implementation Practices
obligations.verbatim: Conduct security testing of the complete system: vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, fuzz testing, security regression testing. Test against known vulnerability databases (CVE, NVD).
extracted_requirements: Include fuzz testing for network-facing and data-parsing components (DICOM ingestion, OTA update receiver)
Run security regression testing after code changes that affect security-relevant components
Verify security controls against the CVE/NVD database — no unmitigated high-severity known vulnerabilities at release

obligations.title: Security Verification Testing
obligations.verbatim: Document known security vulnerabilities and mitigations at release. Provide security guidance for deployment. Generate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM). SBOM must include: component name, version, supplier, dependency relationship, author, timestamp. Machine-readable format required (SPDX or CycloneDX).
extracted_requirements: Generate a machine-readable SBOM at release (SPDX or CycloneDX format)
SBOM must cover all software components including SOUP/third-party libraries

extracted_requirements.SBOM fields required: component name, version, supplier, dependency relationship, author, timestamp

extracted_requirements: Document known residual security vulnerabilities at release with severity and mitigation status
Provide deployment security guidance (network configuration requirements, hardening recommendations)

obligations.title: Secure Release
obligations.verbatim: Continuously monitor for new vulnerabilities affecting the software and its components. Monitor vulnerability databases and SOUP vendor advisories. Establish a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process.
extracted_requirements: Establish a continuous post-market vulnerability monitoring process
Monitor NVD/CVE databases and SOUP vendor advisories for all components in the SBOM
Define severity thresholds and response timelines (e.g., critical CVEs must be assessed within N days)
Establish a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process for third-party security researchers to report vulnerabilities

obligations.title: Post-Market Security Maintenance
obligations.verbatim: Identify assets (data, functions, interfaces). Identify threat agents (malicious users, malware, insider threats, network attackers). Identify threats using a systematic method (STRIDE, attack trees, etc.). Identify vulnerabilities that could be exploited.

extracted_requirements.Conduct a systematic threat model coveri: assets (patient data, guidance algorithms, system configuration), threat agents (network attackers, malicious insiders, compromised SOUP), and threats (STRIDE categories)

extracted_requirements: Identify vulnerabilities exploitable by the identified threats
Threat model must cover all trust boundaries identified in the SAD

obligations.title: Security Records & SBOM
obligations.verbatim: Establish a security incident response process. Define severity classification for security issues. Track security problems to resolution. Report security incidents per regulatory requirements.
extracted_requirements: Define and document a security incident response process
Classify security incidents by severity (e.g., patient safety impact, data breach severity)
Track all security incidents and vulnerabilities from identification to resolution
Report security incidents to FDA per MDR/MAUDE requirements when patient safety is affected
Coordinate with MedTech Company post-market surveillance for cybersecurity-triggered adverse event reporting
